text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp starts today! The students
are
heading to a special academy site for
special
training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course, King Halo is no exception.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Trainer, look well and hard. I'm
going to
need you to remember this
moment moving
forward.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
When you compare my figure from
before summer
to after summer, you'll
be astounded by how
much I'll have
changed in such a short time.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Someday, this lodge will become one of
the
world's leading tourist destinations
as a place
where King Halo once trained!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I believe it's fairly modest in
comparison to
what else I plan to
accomplish.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Speaking of which, there are
various things
I would like to do with this
lodging here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Under my guidance, this place would be
far
better.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's so awfully hot in here. First of all, I'd
have a
much-needed air conditioner
installed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stow my seditious thoughts away and
instead
shift my focus to summer training
with King Halo!
